none: PAS NLM-AA9564: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), probably Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]ENTI[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI P]VBLICAE. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 2.06gms, die axis: 12
